client: Hi Luna, I've been struggling a lot since I lost my grandmother last month. It feels like I can't focus on anything at work, and this overwhelming sadness just keeps creeping in. I find myself questioning if therapy can really help me through this, especially when it feels so heavy.
therapist:
Hi there, it sounds like you’re carrying a heavy burden right now, especially after losing your grandmother. I can sense how deeply this loss is affecting you, and it’s completely understandable to feel overwhelmed and struggle to focus on work. It’s a lot to process, and the sadness can feel all-consuming at times.

You mentioned questioning whether therapy can really help you. It’s normal to feel uncertain when you’re in such a painful space. Remember, it’s okay to seek support. Therapy can be a safe space to explore your feelings and find ways to cope with this grief. 

Could we take a moment to talk about some of the memories you have of your grandmother? Sometimes, sharing those can help bring a little light into the heaviness you’re feeling. I’m here to support you as you navigate through this, and together, we can find a way forward.
vocal_descriptors: very high pitch, moderate volume, moderate-paced speech
